name: Fellowship
author: OpenFF
description: Walk the world together: every OpenFF client with this mod on the same network is a traveller in the same world. See the others walk about your map in their hero's model, speak with F5-F8, send aid to a friend in battle, give items and gil, travel to their side - and Journey together from the title: each player picks one of the four heroes at the crystal shrine and plays the story as them, with saves of their own. A network mod with no server, made of the engine's API.
